audience: Portuguese companies and accountants who prepare invoices in Fiscalo

useCases.title: Check that the key works and which environment it uses
useCases.text: Test the connection with the API key. The answer shows whether the key uses the sandbox or production.

useCases.title: Find a customer and open the record
useCases.text: Search the customers by name, tax number or your own external id, then open one record by its Fiscalo id.

useCases.title: Prepare a draft invoice with lines
useCases.text: Create a draft for a customer in an active series, then add the lines. This tool cannot issue the draft: issuing stays in the Fiscalo Developer Center.

useCases.title: Review documents and their status
useCases.text: List documents with their status, then open one to see its lines, taxes and totals.

useCases.title: Add a product or service to the catalog
useCases.text: Create a product or service with its unit price and tax rate, then list the catalog to check it.
